column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I'm Happy About Going On A Date With My Little Sister - G
If I'm this cold even during summer, I understand why Kirino fell ill after what she did on that winter night.
Rather, Kirino is lucky she didn't freeze to death.
How is it? Do you remember anything?
I don't know... Did I gather any other data?
Yes, you ordered me to get run over by a car at the scramble, then I bought a 30,000 yen accessory from a department store for you...
And lastly, we entered that hotel together over there...*choke*?!
Y-You... what are you doing all of a sudden...
W-W-What hotel... Don't speak about your own perverted delusions to your little sister!
No, it isn't a delusion, it's the scene where the protagonist and a guy named Toshi develop a connection between each other in the novel...
You're always so reckless... You really are an idiot...!
